title: The Mother's Nursery Songs
author: Thomas Hastings

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Hastings (1784–1872) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Mother's Nursery Songs" by Thomas Hastings is a collection of musical and lyrical pieces intended for young children, published during the early 19th century. The book serves as a guide for mothers, offering simple songs to help nurture their children's vocal abilities and enhance their love for music from an early age.
